04 / KEY INTERACTIONS

Urban Oasis is a hotel management dashboard designed to help shift managers oversee daily operations. It brings together critical issues, staff tasks, room status, and employee information in one clear interface, making it easier to prioritize and manage daily work.

Too much information

Hotel management, all in one place

Everything in One Place

Designed for real-time decisions

Managing hotel operations means juggling urgent issues, staff tasks, and room availability. Without a clear overview, prioritizing and responding quickly becomes a challenge.

A simple dashboard that helps hotel staff keep track of daily tasks, spot important issues, and manage everything in one place.

Two key interactions that help hotel staff respond quickly and stay connected.
